paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: you can't earn your way to God, and you don't have to. Israel was running hard after righteousness, and Paul says they were zealous for God (Romans 10:2). But they pursued it "as if it were by works," so they tripped (Romans 9:32). I know a little about trying to do everything my own way and ending up face-first in the chocolate chips.

So what's the way? Paul says it's near. "The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart" (Romans 10:8). If you confess with your mouth, "Jesus is Lord," and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved (Romans 10:9). No climbing to heaven, no digging into the Abyss, because Christ is the end of the law, to bring righteousness to everyone who believes (Romans 10:4, 6-7). And that means EVERYONE, friend. "Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved" (Romans 10:13).

Now here's why it matters to you. Faith comes by hearing, and hearing comes by the word of Christ (Romans 10:17). Somebody told you the good news, and now you get to be one of those beautiful feet (Romans 10:15). And when people turn away, remember the One who said, "All day long I have held out My hands to a disobedient and obstinate people" (Romans 10:21). His hands are still open, baker. Keep yours open too.
